en-US: Connect a phone over USB with USB debugging enabled, or add a wireless device / scan for local emulators using the buttons above.

zh-CN: 连接无线设备时填写名称即可保存，之后可一键连接或开机自动连接。
en-US: Give a wireless device a name when connecting to save it for one-click or automatic reconnection.

zh-CN: 配对成功。请在下方输入手机“无线调试”页面上显示的 IP 地址和端口完成连接。
en-US: Paired. Now enter the IP address and port shown on the phone's Wireless debugging screen to connect.

zh-CN: 没有发现本地模拟器。请确认模拟器已启动并开启了 ADB 调试。
en-US: No local emulators found. Make sure the emulator is running with ADB enabled.

en-US: The device is not authorized. Allow USB debugging in the prompt on the phone.

zh-CN: 设备离线。请重新插拔数据线或重启 USB 调试。
en-US: The device is offline. Reconnect the cable or toggle USB debugging.

zh-CN: 找不到设备，它可能已断开。
en-US: Device not found; it may have been disconnected.

zh-CN: 适用于已开启 TCP 调试（adb tcpip）的设备或局域网内的模拟器。不填端口时默认 5555。
en-US: For devices with TCP debugging enabled (adb tcpip) or emulators on the network. Port defaults to 5555.

zh-CN: Android 11 及以上：在手机“开发者选项 → 无线调试 → 使用配对码配对设备”中查看配对地址和配对码。
en-US: Android 11+: on the phone open Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code.

zh-CN: 配对后，使用“无线调试”页面顶部显示的地址和端口连接（与配对端口不同）。
en-US: After pairing, connect using the address and port shown at the top of the Wireless debugging screen (different from the pairing port).

zh-CN: 依次尝试常见模拟器的本地 ADB 端口（MuMu、雷电、夜神、逍遥、蓝叠等）。
en-US: Tries the local ADB ports used by common emulators (MuMu, LDPlayer, Nox, MEmu, BlueStacks…).
